title: Remote iteration and the full CI gate
summary: The shared router refuses proven unfiltered coverage of every declared test root before publishing or dispatching when the registered full CI gate is available. Before pushing, the remote engine also defers to the project's full CI workflow: while a full run on the same commit is in flight or green it creates no selection run, names that run's URL and adopts its verdict; a selection at or above the full CI share of profiled suite seconds (50%), or whose shards would carry no less than full CI's, is refused with the full gate's command, and the selection workflow's plan job refuses the same work before any shard starts. Recovery names the attached QA requirement or its lookup. Iterate with targeted files/node IDs or bounded impacted selection before the QA case, then execute the attached full gate once. Nonempty keyword/marker filters, collect-only, CI execution and explicit local outage checks retain their routes; empty effective expressions are diagnosed. Source behavior and focused fixture tests do not establish deployed proof.
